Notes: MapBackDoors: Deep Woods adds a stop to the vanilla minecart network (DeepWoodsContentAdder.EditMinecarts), open once the level 1 map exists, and level 1's top edge leads to Woods 26 31 (DeepWoods.Warp). So wherever the minecarts run, Deep Woods and the Secret Woods need no steel axe. In a year-1 loop the minecarts run from day 1 only with Keep Minecarts, so the back door carries WhenUpgrade keep_minecarts and those saves read their own variant (walked in game 2026-11-06: out of Deep Woods' top edge into the Woods, then across them). | Depth is matched by monsters (Jeff, 2026-11-05): levels 1 to 9 hold nothing past mines floor 119 and open with the Secret Woods at week 4; from level 10 they hold Skull Cavern monsters, so a deepwoods:level 10+ route waits for the mines to be cleared (MineDepth, FairnessRule). Each route names location:DeepWoods (the week 4 gate, MapWeekGate) and deepwoods:level N. | Mushrooms: measured live, 17 fresh levels (2 to 8) gave 199 mushrooms, about 7 common, 2.3 chanterelle, 1.5 morel, 0.6 red and 0.24 purple a level, so a player walking a few levels a day finds enough of the first four for a gate (Dependable) and purple is luck (Chance). Deep Woods ignores the season for them. | Entrance fruit: the three trees on level 1 are rolled once per load, 1 in 7 each for every type, and only bear in their own season (FruitTree.TryAddFruit), so each fruit is Chance in its season. | (O)834 Mango is left out and ruled YearTwo (Jeff, 2026-11-05: an item counts only if a player visiting every day of the week has a reasonable chance of enough for a gate): a mango tree is on the entrance in about 37% of loads and bears only in Summer. | Fruit on level 5+ fruit trees is not mapped separately: the same seven types, random and in season, are already Chance through the entrance routes; mango is left out for the same reason as above. | Flowers: fully grown wild flower crops from level 3 (tulip, blue jazz, summer spangle, poppy, fairy rose; only blue jazz and fairy rose in Winter); not measured, so Chance. | Clearings (level 30+): treasure chest items, the iridium tree (iridium axe) and the lake fish are Chance; the lake pick is luck-gated (ChanceForAwesomeFish) and ignores season, weather and fishing level, so these are Fish routes, not FishSpawns rows, which would add vanilla fish rules the lottery does not have. | Left out: trash bins (junk), the gingerbread house (level 50, gold axe; its foods are cookable dishes with their own routes), the Unicorn Stardrop (no board or cart use; its rewind is handled in TLY), Excalibur (a weapon built in code, not in the item data), monster drops (the same vanilla monsters as the mines and Skull Cavern, no earlier than their own routes), bushes, weeds, twigs and stones (no item TLY needs from them), and ChanceForExtraForageable (0 at default settings). | Midnight Carp (269) and a Grey Wolf Cane are not in Deep Woods' fish or item tables; this layer has nothing to do with Nexus bug 1166150.
